2607.29250.title: Data Turnstile: A Scalable Open Framework for Function-Calling Data Generation
2607.29250.paper_summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive for agentic deployment due to low latency, reduced cost, and on-device privacy, yet they struggle with tool-use tasks where training data is scarce and noisy. Unlike larger models, SLMs cannot compensate for low-quality supervision through sheer capacity, making data quality the critical bottleneck. We present Data Turnstile, an open-source framework that takes user-defined API specifications and generates high-quality synthetic training data for function calling. Turnstile decomposes multi-turn tool-use interactions into constrained, stepwise generation with validation and error-feedback loops, providing fine-grained control over API diversity, conversation complexity, and output correctness. We demonstrate effectiveness of domain adaptation with Turnstile data on two challenging function calling benchmarks. On the BFCL single-turn benchmark, a Qwen3-0.6B fine-tuned on Turnstile data without chain-of-thought achieves 75.9% overall accuracy (versus 67.4% for the base model with thinking enabled), closing the gap with thinking-enabled Qwen3-1.7B (78.4%) and Qwen3-4B (79.9%) despite being 3$\times$ and 7$\times$ smaller respectively. On $τ^2$-bench, a multi-turn agentic benchmark, Turnstile-trained Qwen3-1.7B achieves 31.1% pass^1 on the Telecom domain, improving 4.7$\times$ over its 6.6% base and surpassing Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (27.4%), a model 19$\times$ larger. Turnstile-trained Qwen3-0.6B achieves 24.6%, improving 7$\times$ over its 3.5% base and approaching the 32B model (53$\times$ larger). We release Data Turnstile along with a dataset spanning 1,000+ APIs and 100K+ multi-turn interactions.
2607.29250.paper_summary_zh: 小型語言模型（SLMs）因為低延遲、降低成本和設備上的隱私而在代理部署中具有吸引力，但它們在訓練數據稀少且噪音較大的工具使用任務中掙扎。與較大的模型不同，SLMs無法通過單純的容量來補償低質量的監督，使得數據質量成為關鍵瓶頸。我們提出了Data Turnstile，一個開源框架，該框架接受用戶定義的API規範並生成高質量的合成訓練數據以進行函數調用。Turnstile將多輪工具使用互動分解為受限的逐步生成，並包含驗證和錯誤反饋循環，提供對API多樣性、對話複雜性和輸出正確性的細緻控制。我們展示了在兩個具有挑戰性的函數調用基準上，使用Turnstile數據進行領域適應的有效性。在BFCL單輪基準上，經過Turnstile數據微調的Qwen3-0.6B在未啟用思考的情況下達到了75.9%的整體準確率（相比之下，基礎模型啟用思考時為67.4%），縮小了與啟用思考的Qwen3-1.7B（78.4%）和Qwen3-4B（79.9%）之間的差距，儘管它們的大小分別為3$\times$和7$\times$。在$τ^2$-bench這個多輪代理基準上，經過Turnstile訓練的Qwen3-1.7B在電信領域達到了31.1%的通過率^1，較其6.6%的基礎提升了4.7$\times$，並超過了Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct（27.4%），這是一個大19$\times$的模型。經過Turnstile訓練的Qwen3-0.6B達到了24.6%，較其3.5%的基礎提升了7$\times$，並接近32B模型（大53$\times$）。我們發布了Data Turnstile，並附帶了一個涵蓋1,000多個API和100K多個多輪互動的數據集。
